title: Silver Account specifications and requirements
summary: This document specifies Silver Account requirements: $500 minimum opening deposit, $1,000 ongoing minimum balance per statement cycle, 10 free withdrawals per statement cycle, and daily interest compounding. It also defines a $10,000 balance threshold to qualify for a higher APY tier and notes possible excess withdrawal fees beyond 10.
faqs: What is the minimum deposit required to open a Silver Account?
What ongoing minimum balance do I need to avoid monthly fees?
How many free withdrawals are allowed per statement cycle?
